'''Wollok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Corellian Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Security Force sided with the Republic during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Wollok was stationed in the Republic-controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. There, he worked as a medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] while wearing [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and grey armor, and a helmet. Wollok had dark skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wollok appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Medium Armor Vendor for Republic players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Wollok was removed from the game along with the rest of the Medium Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
